searched_sources: Communauté Islamique en République Démocratique du Congo (COMICO - Kinshasa)
WorldCat for Lingala/Swahili/French Quran prints in DRC
notes: COMICO and Congolese mosques utilize French and Swahili Quran translations imported from Saudi Arabia (King Fahd Complex), Tanzania (Islamic Propagation Centre, Dar es Salaam), and Kenya; no domestic Quran printing press in Kinshasa.
